description: Source file for GatewayDiscoveryModel, which manages discovery and tracking of network gateways using Bonjour/mDNS via Network framework, including debugging and status functionalities.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: Final class responsible for discovering network gateways, maintaining their list, statuses, and debug logs.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.DebugLogEntry
classes.description: Struct representing a debug log entry with timestamp and message.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.DiscoveredGateway
classes.description: Struct representing a discovered network gateway with properties like name, endpoint, ports, and security info.

methods.name: setDebugLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug logging and manages the debug log entries accordingly.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the network gateway discovery process by setting up network browsers for configured domains.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the discovery process and clears active browsers and results.

methods.name: recomputeGateways
methods.description: Recomputes the list of gateways based on current domain results, tracking added and removed gateways.

methods.name: updateStatusText
methods.description: Updates the status text based on current browser states and activity.

methods.name: prettyState
methods.description: Converts NWBrowser.State enums into human-readable strings.

methods.name: appendDebugLog
methods.description: Adds a message to the debug log if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: prettifyInstanceName
methods.description: Normalizes and cleans up instance names for display purposes.

methods.name: txtValue
methods.description: Retrieves a trimmed string value for a key from a dictionary, returns nil if empty.

methods.name: txtIntValue
methods.description: Parses and returns an integer value from a dictionary key.

methods.name: txtBoolValue
methods.description: Determines boolean value from a string in a dictionary.
